answer: Sealed roll-call challenges make each identity answer a fresh prompt a live model alone can produce distinctly: a signed relic seeds the prompt pool, a per-identity marble nonce selects one, and a hidden fable decoy flags replays. Entry costs a per-identity bond, each attempt burns a fee, with a rate cap and seven-day trust ramp. A ring fails because copied answers collide on the nonce, decoys expose shared scripts, and a five-member quorum cross-check makes each fake identity costlier than its rewards.
